purpose: Coverage-first measurement of the first non-pass task in the fixed 189-task development ledger under the unchanged current generic candidate.
change_scope: No task-driven code change. Measure the unchanged generic candidate on the first non-pass ledger task using a fresh VM and immutable result directory.

implementation_evidence.parent_diagnosis: The model selected the correct spreadsheet reader but inferred the wrong directory. The downstream missing-file error returned no candidate path, after which the model repeated path guesses and unrelated searches. The no-progress window stopped the Agent loop after 51.255 seconds; evaluator reward was 0.0 and the strict audit was valid.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_scope: Tests use unrelated Regional Budget workbooks in multiple synthetic directories. They require exact basename matching, spreadsheet suffix filtering, depth/directory/result bounds, explicit model retry, unchanged successful argument forwarding, and no automatic candidate execution.
implementation_evidence.instruction_top_k: unchanged public action selection and Top-K; only the existing spreadsheet reader schema documents its missing-path retry contract
implementation_evidence.focused_tests: 98 passed plus one direct counterfactual recovery check
implementation_evidence.ruff: changed active source and tests passed lint and format checks
implementation_evidence.project_layout: passed, including generic deployment leakage scan
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes

protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit the untouched baseline, classify the failure, and do not rerun it unchanged. Try at most three materially different generic hypotheses with one targeted A/B each. If all three fail, mark the task task_blocked and immediately advance to the next ledger entry.

selection.method: first non-pass in the task-ID-deduplicated development coverage ledger
